name: Split button
summary: Button's split variant: a main action joined to a caret that opens a menu of related actions, such as Present with Present from start / from current slide.
highlights: Main action and caret menu in one shape
Two real buttons: each half hovers, presses and takes focus on its own
Reuses aha-button and aha-dropdown, no copied styles
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-split-button>, defined once and imported unchanged by React and Vue. It is Button's split variant: the main half is an <aha-button> (label slot, optional slot="icon") and the caret half is an icon-only <aha-button> with the system-caret-down glyph, slotted as the trigger of an <aha-dropdown>. So every per-state value (fill, label, hover, press, focus ring, disabled, heights, radius, spinner) is the Button's own, and the menu is the Dropdown's own (rows, icons, dividers, danger, locked rows, flyouts, roving keys, top-layer placement). The outer corners keep the size's radius, the inner corners are square, and a 1px divider separates the halves: white at 24% on primary, the default border #E3E3E3 on secondary. A click on the main half is the native `click`; choosing a row emits `select` (detail { key }). The Button API is unchanged.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, so the render is identical. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `click` and `select`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The halves are the shipped aha-button and aha-dropdown, defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Shape
spec.value: two aha-buttons side by side, no gap; outer corners keep the size's radius (sm r4, md and lg r8), inner corners square

spec.label: Sizes
spec.value: sm 28 · md 36 · lg 40 (default), the aha-button heights; the caret half is the icon-only square of that size (28 / 36 / 40) with the 16px system-caret-down

spec.label: Primary
spec.value: both halves bg #E70E68, label #FFFFFF, hover #DB005B + soft pink shadow on the hovered half only; 1px divider white at 24% (color-mix of --aha-white) on the caret's start edge

spec.label: Secondary
spec.value: both halves white with the 1px #E3E3E3 border; the halves share one border edge (the divider); the hovered half's #E70E68 border and pale pink fill show on all four sides

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: each half draws aha-button's own 2px Vivid Pink ring outside a 2px gap, raised above the other half

spec.label: Caret
spec.value: aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, aria-label from caret-label (default More options); opens on click, Enter, Space and ArrowDown; the glyph turns 180° while open (motion-mid, ease-in-out)

spec.label: Menu
spec.value: aha-dropdown's panel, placed bottomRight by default so it lines up with the split's right edge; `placement` overrides

spec.label: Disabled / loading
spec.value: disabled greys and disables both halves and closes the menu; loading shows the spinner on the main half only and blocks its click, the caret stays usable

props.name: variant
props.desc: the tone of both halves, as on aha-button; one primary per view

props.name: size
props.desc: 28 / 36 / 40px, the aha-button heights; the caret half is the icon-only square of the same size

props.name: items
props.desc: the caret menu's rows, exactly aha-dropdown's items: leaf {key,label,description?,icon?,disabled?,danger?}, locked leaf, submenu-parent {children:[…]}, {type:"divider"}, {type:"group"}. Also a property that takes an array

props.name: caret-label
props.desc: the caret half's accessible name; name what the menu holds (More present options)

props.name: placement
props.desc: where the menu opens, as on aha-dropdown

props.name: loading
props.desc: the main half shows the spinner and ignores clicks; the caret stays usable

props.name: slot icon
props.desc: an optional leading glyph on the main half, as aha-button's slot="icon"

props.name: click / select
props.desc: `click` fires for the main half only; `select` (composed, detail { key }) when a menu row is chosen; the menu's `open` / `close` bubble out too

whenToUse.when: one action people take most of the time, with a few close variants of the same action behind it: Present with Present from start / from current slide, Share with Copy link / Invite by email
there is one action and no variants
there is no default action: every choice is equal and the trigger only opens the list

opinion.note: The main half must do something on its own; if the label only opens the menu, use a Dropdown. Keep the menu to variants of the main action, not unrelated actions. Name the caret with caret-label. Do not join an aha-button and an aha-dropdown by hand with ::part radius or margins: use this element.
opinion.dsv3: GAP FILLED — DS V3 has no split button; this joins the V3 Button and the V3 Dropdown-Menu, following Ant Design Dropdown.Button.

snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). The probe is the primary lg Present split; the secondary lg split gives the shared border edge.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-split-button[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;var m=r&&r.querySelector('.main');var c=r&&r.querySelector('.caret');var mb=m&&m.shadowRoot&&m.shadowRoot.querySelector('button');var cb=c&&c.shadowRoot&&c.shadowRoot.querySelector('button');if(!mb||!cb)return null;var ms=getComputedStyle(mb);var cs=getComputedStyle(cb);var mr=mb.getBoundingClientRect();var cr=cb.getBoundingClientRect();var sec=document.querySelector('aha-split-button[variant="secondary"][size="lg"]');var sc=sec&&sec.shadowRoot.querySelector('.caret').shadowRoot.querySelector('button');var ss=sc?getComputedStyle(sc):null;return{bg:ms.backgroundColor,label:ms.color,caretBg:cs.backgroundColor,height:ms.height,caretHeight:cs.height,caretWidth:cs.width,outerRadius:ms.borderTopLeftRadius,caretOuterRadius:cs.borderTopRightRadius,innerSquare:ms.borderTopRightRadius==='0px'&&cs.borderTopLeftRadius==='0px',joined:Math.round(cr.left-mr.right)===0,dividerOnPrimary:/^rgba\(255, 255, 255, 0\.24\)$/.test(cs.borderLeftColor),secondaryDivider:ss?ss.borderLeftColor:null,caretHaspopup:c.getAttribute('aria-haspopup'),caretExpanded:c.getAttribute('aria-expanded'),caretLabel:c.getAttribute('aria-label'),caretIcon:!!c.querySelector('aha-icon[name="system-caret-down"]')};})()

selfCheck.label: both halves are shipped aha-buttons; the menu is the shipped aha-dropdown
outer corners keep the size radius, inner corners square
1px divider: white 24% on primary, #E3E3E3 on secondary; no raw hex
each half hovers, presses and focuses on its own; the focused half sits above the other
caret: aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, aria-label; opens on click, Enter, Space, ArrowDown
disabled disables both halves; loading spins the main half only
shadow DOM built once; attribute changes patch persistent nodes
